gizlilik_h6: 6. Transfer of Data to Third Parties (Domestic and International)

cerez_p1: Cookies are small text files saved on your computer or mobile device when you visit our website. Cookies are widely used to make websites work or work more efficiently and to provide information to site owners.
cerez_p2: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website for the following purposes:
cerez_p3:
Essential Cookies: These cookies are essential for you to navigate the website and use its features.
Performance Cookies: These cookies collect information about how you use our websites.
Targeting Cookies: These cookies are used to provide advertising that is more relevant to you and your interests.
cerez_p4: You can manage or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete any cookies already on your computer and set most browsers to prevent cookies from being placed. However, if you do this, you may need to manually adjust some preferences each time you visit a site, and some services and functions may not work.
cerez_h5: 5. Cookies According to Purpose of Use: Mandatory Cookies
cerez_p5: These are cookies that are absolutely necessary for the website to function correctly and securely. They are used to log in users, access encrypted fields, and verify form submissions. The use of these cookies is not subject to your consent; If they are closed, the basic functions of the website will not work.
cerez_p6: These are cookies that offer a more personalized experience by remembering visitors' past choices on the website (e.g. language preference, text size, theme - dark/light mode). If you reject the use of these cookies, the site will treat you as a new user each time you visit and you will have to set your preferences from the beginning.
cerez_p7: These are cookies that collect anonymous data about how our website is used. They help us improve the architecture and speed of our site by collecting statistics such as page load times, error messages, and most visited pages. Our company uses third-party analytics tools such as Google Analytics for this purpose.
cerez_p8: These are cookies used to offer campaigns tailored to your interests, to limit the number of times an ad is shown to you, and to measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. Cookies of advertising networks such as Meta (Facebook) Pixel and Google Ads fall into this category. If you do not accept these cookies, you will still see general advertisements on the internet, but these advertisements will not be specific to you.

Internet browsers are usually configured to automatically accept cookies. However, you can change your browser settings to reject cookies altogether, block certain types of cookies, or receive a warning when a cookie is stored:
- Google Chrome: Settings > Privacy and Security > Cookies and Other Site Data
- Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Block Cookies
Please note that if you block Mandatory Cookies, our system (e.g. dues payment module) may not work.

kvkk_page_desc: The security and privacy of your personal data is a top priority for us.
kvkk_p1: Alo Management Services Inc. As such, in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), your personal data will be recorded, stored, updated, disclosed / transferred to third parties where the legislation allows, classified and processed in the ways listed in the KVKK, within the framework explained in this clarification text.
kvkk_p2: Your collected personal data is processed for the purposes of carrying out the necessary work by our business units to benefit you from the services offered by our company, tracking site management fees, carrying out legal processes and ensuring building security (CCTV records, license plate recognition).
kvkk_h3: 3. To whom and for what purpose the processed data can be transferred
kvkk_p3: Your personal data may be transferred to authorized public institutions and organizations in order to fulfill our legal obligations, to our company lawyers to resolve legal disputes, and to contracted banks for dues collection processes.
kvkk_p4: To exercise your rights under Article 11 of the KVKK, you can contact us at kvkk@aloyonetim.com.tr.
kvkk_p5:
Your personal data is collected based on the processing conditions specified in Articles 5 and 6 of the KVKK. These are basically:
- It is clearly foreseen in the laws (Condominium Law etc.),
- It is directly related to the establishment or execution of a contract (Execution of the management contract),
- It is mandatory for the data controller to fulfill its legal obligation,
- It is necessary to process data for the legitimate interests of the data controller, provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.
kvkk_h6: 6. Methods of Collection of Personal Data
kvkk_p6: Your data is collected in physical and digital environments. These are: Information update forms that you fill out and submit to the management office, notifications made via e-mail and call center, legal notifications from official institutions (Land Registry Offices, Population Directorates), registration/payment screens on our website/mobile application, PTS cameras at vehicle entrances and common area security cameras.
kvkk_h7: 7. Data Processing with Camera (CCTV) and Security Systems
kvkk_p7: In the sites that our company manages, 24/7 security camera monitoring is carried out in common areas (entrance doors, lobby, parking lot, elevator interiors, garden) in order to ensure building security and crime prevention. Warning signs "Monitored by Camera 24/7" are visibly hung in the camera recording areas. The cameras are positioned in such a way that they cannot see the inside of the apartment (private areas). Camera recordings are stored for an average of 15-30 days and are automatically deleted by the system.
kvkk_h8: 8. Use of License Plate Recognition System (PTS)
kvkk_p8: PTS is used to ensure security in the parking areas of your site and to speed up transitions. Your vehicle license plates are defined as 'Authorized Vehicle' in our system. This data is processed only for the purpose of ensuring site security and is not shared with any institution or organization unless there is a legal investigation (Police, Prosecutor's Office).
kvkk_h9: 9. Parties to which Personal Data May Be Transferred
kvkk_p9:
Your data; It can only be transferred to achieve the purposes described above and within the limits specified in Article 8 of the KVKK:
- To Law Offices and Lawyers with whom the Company has a contract for enforcement proceedings and resolution of legal disputes,
- To Financial Advisors and Independent Audit Firms for tax and financial audits,
- To domestic/foreign companies from which we receive server (hosting), SMS integrator and cloud computing services to provide digital services. to suppliers,
- In case of legal request, to Authorized Public Institutions and Organizations such as Police Departments, Prosecutor's Office, Courts, SSI, Tax Offices.
kvkk_p10: Since the cloud-based servers (AWS, Azure, etc.), e-mail servers (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365) and WhatsApp communication channels used in our systems are located abroad, your data can be transferred abroad by taking the necessary administrative and technical security measures in accordance with Article 9 of the KVKK, due to the necessity of using relevant technologies.
kvkk_h11: 11. Rights of the Relevant Person (Data Owner)
kvkk_p11:
In accordance with Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the following rights as the data owner:
a) Learning whether personal data is being processed,
b) Requesting information if the data has been processed,
c) Learning the purpose of processing and whether it is used in accordance with its purpose,
d) Knowing the third parties to whom it is transferred domestically or abroad,
e) Requesting correction of the data if it is incomplete or incorrectly processed,
f) KVKK. Requesting the deletion or destruction of the data within the framework of the conditions in Article 7,
g) Objecting to a result against you arising from the analysis of the processed data exclusively through automatic systems,
h) Requesting compensation for the damage if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing.
kvkk_h12: 12. Exercise of Rights and Application Method
kvkk_p12: In order to exercise your rights and submit your requests specified in Article 11 of the KVKK, you can send an e-mail to info@aloyonetim.com.tr via your e-mail address registered in our system. Our company will finalize the request free of charge as soon as possible and within thirty (30) days at the latest, depending on the nature of the request.
